installCommand: echo 'no install: the course build uses only Node built-ins'
ignoreCommand: P="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^}"; git cat-file -e "$P^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch --quiet --depth=1000 origin "$P" 2>/dev/null || git fetch --quiet --unshallow 2>/dev/null; git cat-file -e "$P^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || exit 1; git diff --quiet "$P" HEAD -- .

headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
